title: College Basketball
description:
Valparaiso at Purdue
The Purdue Boilermakers clash with the Valparaiso Beacons in regular NCAA play. Purdue relies on junior Daniel Jacobsen following his strong frontcourt debut against Gonzaga, while Valparaiso counts on quick transition scoring and 11 team assists.

title: College Football
description:
Maryland at Purdue
The Terrapins (2-6, 0-5 Big Ten) try to snap a six-game slide as they visit the Boilermakers (3-5, 2-3). Purdue has dropped two straight after prevailing in the previous two. Boilermakers sophomore running back Fame Ijeboi boasts 10 touchdowns.

title: College Football
description:
Rutgers at Wisconsin
The Badgers (5-3, 3-2 Big Ten) try to continue their mastery of the Scarlet Knights (2-6, 1-4). The Badgers have won all six get-togethers, by an average of 30 points. Wisconsin tries to get its offense back in gear following a 30-0 loss to Iowa.
